objective: Test whether the scalar collisions introduced by REL_INC-ZOE are repaired by the already-frozen remaining-local-capacity distinction, without restoring arbitrary exact component identity.
motivation: EW-RS-051 rejects both REL_INC-ZOE and TOPO_RPAR-ZOE on every demanding derivation carrier while exact-type ZOE remains Q-V exact.

Minimum REL_INC-ZOE collisions repeatedly replace component types with the same frontier-relative residual-incidence descriptor but different absolute local frontier/capacity, including 2|| versus 3|| and 1|4| versus 2|8|.
CAP6_REL_INC and CAP_REL_INC were defined outcome-independently before this experiment.
In EW-RS-035/036, CAP6_REL_INC recovered the complete observed degree-2 structural interaction span on 5x3-k3, 4x4-k4, and 6x3-k3.

frozenCountState.name: ZOE
frozenCountState.definition: For each retained structural identity: omit zero count, emit O for positive odd total multiplicity, emit E for positive even total multiplicity.

frozenDescriptorCandidates.name: CAP6_REL_INC_ZOE
frozenDescriptorCandidates.definition: Map each exact component to (REL_INC, component width, remaining local capacity mod 6); sum multiplicities over equal descriptors; apply ZOE.

frozenDescriptorCandidates.name: CAP_REL_INC_ZOE
frozenDescriptorCandidates.definition: Map each exact component to (REL_INC, component width, exact remaining local capacity); sum multiplicities over equal descriptors; apply ZOE.

antiCircularity: REL_INC, CAP6_REL_INC, and CAP_REL_INC were defined before EW-RS-051 collision outcomes were observed.
The capacity value is computed only from current component width, board height, and local column frontier heights.
Counts are aggregated by the frozen descriptor before ZOE classification.
No W/D/L label selects a component, capacity residue, merge, phase grade, or coefficient.
falsifiers: Any mixed scalar-value EXACT_ZOE class invalidates the established control.
Any mixed scalar-value CAP6_REL_INC_ZOE class rejects capacity-mod-6 relative-incidence aggregation on that carrier.
Any mixed scalar-value CAP_REL_INC_ZOE class rejects exact-capacity relative-incidence aggregation on that carrier.
nextIfCap6CommonSuccess: Freeze CAP6_REL_INC_ZOE as the current structural identity compression and qualify it unchanged on predeclared fresh non-affine 5x4-k4 before decoder discovery.
nextIfExactCapacityOnly: Freeze CAP_REL_INC_ZOE and localize the capacity-mod-6 alias that causes CAP6 failure before any finer identity feature is added.
nextIfBothFail: Freeze the minimum collision families and inspect only the exact component distinctions still erased after exact capacity plus REL_INC; do not return to arbitrary exact IDs.
interpretationGuards: Passing establishes bounded Q-V sufficiency only, not Q-A/Q-F.
Capacity is retained as a structural descriptor coordinate, not as an outcome-fitted phase.
No standard-7x6 or universal theorem follows.
